candidates.publisher: Oxford Robotics Institute — Dynamic Robot Systems Group
candidates.title: OASIS-Map: Object-Level Change Detection in Multi-Session Mapping using Semantic Correspondence Matching
candidates.finding: Oxford researchers publicly describe multi-session mapping with dense image-patch semantic correspondences, incremental object association and change labels of static, appeared, disappeared, moved, or unknown. The paper evaluates car replacement, indoor 3RScan rearrangements and an outdoor market; these are author-reported inspection/mapping results, not HILO household-retention findings.
candidates.hilo_adaptation: Propose a non-ranking synthetic repeated-visit regression fixture that distinguishes persistent, moved and uncertain objects; preserve unknown until sufficient observation, record gaps and intervention events separately. Do not infer long-term resident hours, individual consent, privacy rights, or WANTED performance from change detection.
